summary: This memo proposes a protocol that, given a TCP port pair, returns a string naming the owner of that connection on the server's system. Suggested uses include identifying users during FTP sessions. It was replaced by RFC 931.

eli5.summary: You ask a computer, "Who is using this connection?" and it answers with a name. This was an early try at that idea.

questions: what is the early authentication service protocol
how to identify the user of a tcp connection
